SequencePang2 audio sketch v1 — 2026-10-04

This pack was created for the user's SequencePang2 project. Its note sequences,
harmony, arrangement, synthesis code and rendered sounds were newly generated
in this task. The sounds use mathematical oscillators, noise, envelopes and
filters. No external recordings, third-party sample packs, SoundFonts or
commercial music-generation-service outputs are embedded.

The package is supplied as editable project material: rendered WAV/OGG,
reference MP3, symbolic scores and the synthesis source. There is no included
third-party audio asset requiring a separate sample-library license.

The process was AI-assisted. This provenance statement is not a guarantee of
copyright exclusivity or a legal determination of copyrightability.
Runtime tools used: Python, NumPy, SciPy and FFmpeg. Those tools are not bundled.
